name: VAPT Passive Scanner and AI Report

parameters.formDescription: Enter a target URL you are authorised to test. Only passive, non-intrusive checks are performed.

values.option: Yes, I am authorised to test this target

values.formSubmittedText: Scan started. The report will be sent to your Telegram chat in about a minute.

nodes.name: Target URL Form
nodes.notes: Entry point. Collects the target URL, an authorisation confirmation and the Telegram chat ID that receives the report.

nodes.name: Validate URL
nodes.notes: Normalises the URL, checks scheme / domain format, blocks localhost and private IP ranges (SSRF guard) and requires the authorisation confirmation.

nodes.name: URL Valid?
nodes.notes: True: run the scans. False: tell the user why the input was rejected.

nodes.name: Check HTTP Status and Redirect
nodes.notes: Requests the plain-HTTP URL without following redirects to see whether it upgrades to HTTPS.

nodes.name: Merge Scan Results
nodes.notes: Waits for all six parallel checks to finish before scoring.

nodes.name: Check Security Headers
nodes.notes: Fetches the target (following redirects) and records response headers: HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Server, etc.

nodes.name: Check Cookie Flags
nodes.notes: Separate request to the site root to capture Set-Cookie headers (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite).

nodes.name: Fetch robots.txt
nodes.notes: Looks for robots.txt and any sensitive paths it discloses.

nodes.name: Check SSL/TLS
nodes.notes: HTTPS request with strict certificate validation. A failure (expired, self-signed, hostname mismatch) is captured as the error message.

nodes.name: DNS and IP Lookup
nodes.notes: Resolves A records through Google DNS-over-HTTPS to get IP details.

nodes.name: Notify Invalid Input
nodes.notes: Error handling: reports a rejected URL back to the user.

nodes.name: Score Findings
nodes.notes: Applies severity rules (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info) to every check and produces one structured JSON document.

parameters.text:
=Write the VAPT report for this assessment data (JSON):
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

options.systemMessage:
You are a senior penetration tester with 15 years of experience writing client-ready VAPT reports. You are given structured JSON from an automated, passive assessment. Use ONLY the facts in the JSON. Never invent findings, versions, or evidence. Be professional, precise and concise.

Output Markdown only, with EXACTLY these sections in this order and these headings:

# VAPT Report: <domain>
## 1. Title Page Details
(bullet list: Report title, Target, Domain, Date, Overall risk rating, Prepared by "Automated VAPT Workflow (reviewed by AI senior tester)", Classification "Confidential")
## 2. Executive Summary
(2 short paragraphs for a non-technical reader, plus the count of findings per severity)
## 3. Scope and Methodology
(scope = target URL only; methodology = passive checks: HTTP status and redirect, security headers, cookie flags, robots.txt and sitemap.xml, TLS, DNS; state no exploitation was performed and list limitations such as no authenticated or active testing)
## 4. Findings Table
(Markdown table with columns: ID | Title | Severity | Evidence. One row per finding, ordered Critical to Info, using the IDs from the JSON.)
## 5. Detailed Findings
(For every finding with severity other than Info: "### <ID> - <Title> (<Severity>)" followed by bullets **Description**, **Evidence**, **Impact**. Summarise Info findings in one short paragraph.)
## 6. Remediation
(For every finding other than Info: "### <ID> - <Title>" followed by concrete remediation steps, with a sample configuration line where relevant.)
## 7. Conclusion
(short closing paragraph with prioritised next steps)

Do not add any text before or after the report.

nodes.name: AI Report Writer
nodes.notes: Senior-penetration-tester persona. A fixed output format is enforced by the system prompt.

nodes.name: Markdown to HTML
nodes.notes: Converts the AI report (Markdown) to HTML with table support.

nodes.name: Build Report File
nodes.notes: Wraps the report in a styled HTML document and stores it as binary file VAPT_<domain>_<date>.html (print to PDF from any browser).

nodes.name: Send Report via Telegram
nodes.notes: Delivers the report file to the Telegram chat given in the form.

nodeGroups.name: Validate and scan target
nodeGroups.description: Takes the submitted URL, rejects bad input, then runs six passive checks in parallel and joins them

nodeGroups.name: Score and write report
nodeGroups.description: Rates every finding by severity, then an AI senior tester writes the full report in a fixed format

nodeGroups.name: Deliver report file
nodeGroups.description: Saves the report as VAPT_domain_date and sends it to the requester on Telegram
